edits.old: This story builds the harness and the evidence only. It builds no production screen, endpoint, table, workflow or schedule, and it owns no table. The real behaviour is owned by the three I stories RWB-P3-E2015-APP (the two read operations, the timer ordering, the escalation fields, the prescription warning and the merge in rwb-case), RWB-S8-E2015-APP (the deviation query, the pause and the clear of the stage clock, the contact stop and the return point) and RWB-P4-E2015-APP (the role, scope and Case record right check), and those three stories block the ITG run.
edits.new:
This story builds the harness and the evidence only. It builds no production screen, endpoint, table, workflow or schedule, and it owns no table. The real behaviour is owned by the three I stories RWB-P3-E2015-APP (the two read operations, the timer ordering, the escalation fields, the prescription warning and the merge in rwb-case), RWB-S8-E2015-APP (the deviation query, the pause and the clear of the stage clock, the contact stop and the return point) and RWB-P4-E2015-APP (the role, scope and Case record right check), and those three stories block the ITG run. It is small: it fits within two weeks.

Open decisions DL10 and DL22 remain open. Assumptions ASM-2250, ASM-2357, ASM-2377 and ASM-2863 (DL10) and ASM-1162, ASM-1304, ASM-2217 and ASM-2569 (DL22) are confirmed by the programme directive of 26 November 2026, and the harness runs on them.
